company.name: Rent A Boat Villy
company.address: New Port of Limenaria, Thassos 640 02, Greece

sections.heading: Who we are
sections.body: Rent A Boat Villy operates thassosboats.gr and provides hourly self-drive boat rental from New Port of Limenaria, Thassos, Greece. Questions: vilitrifonova245@gmail.com. Data protection: vilitrifonova245@gmail.com.

sections.heading: What we collect
sections.body: When you send a booking request we collect the details you enter: name, email, phone, ID/passport number, date, boat preference, guests, and any notes. We also store your cookie consent choice and language preference.

sections.heading: Why we use it
sections.body: We use this information to reply to your request, confirm availability, prepare your boat rental, and run the website. We keep booking records as long as needed for our operations and any legal requirements.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.body: You can ask to access, correct, or delete your data where the law allows. Use the form at /gdpr or email vilitrifonova245@gmail.com.

sections.heading: Cookies we use
sections.body: We use cookies and similar storage to remember your language and cookie choices. Analytics and marketing cookies are off unless you enable them.

sections.heading: Necessary
sections.body: tbc-consent stores your cookie preferences. tbc-lang stores your language. These are required for the site to work as intended.

sections.heading: Your choices
sections.body: Open Cookie Settings in the footer to change preferences at any time.

sections.heading: Contact us
sections.body: For rates, availability, fuel policy, and all rental details, call +30 698 131 8393 or +40 770 965 041, email vilitrifonova245@gmail.com, or visit our office at New Port of Limenaria, Thassos.

sections.heading: Basics
sections.body: Fuel not included. Safety briefing at the marina. Booking subject to availability.

sections.heading: Booking requests
sections.body: A request on this website is not a confirmed booking until we contact you.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.body: You may ask us to access, correct, delete, or restrict use of your personal data, or to receive a copy in a portable format, where applicable law allows.

sections.heading: Contact us
sections.body: Use the form below or email vilitrifonova245@gmail.com. We aim to respond within 30 days.
